The Paper Trail Loop

Find → Verify → Brief → Reuse → Reverify.

A better playbook can make research more consistent. It never makes a prior conclusion current or property-specific.

Delivery

Start with the customer question and current primary sources.

  1. 01
    Find.

    Identify the responsible jurisdiction and applicable current official sources.

  2. 02
    Verify.

    Connect material facts to sources and retrieval dates; label inference, conflicts, and unknowns.

  3. 03
    Brief.

    Build the concise timeline, usable summary, gaps, and next calls.

  4. 04
    Reuse carefully.

    Keep only anonymized source maps, query patterns, failure patterns, and checklist improvements.

  5. 05
    Reverify.

    Reopen current primary sources and rerun the property-specific search on every new case.

No self-training claim

Completed work may improve non-sensitive operating knowledge. Names, contact details, addresses, private documents, and free-text requests stay out of reusable playbooks and analytics. Every new conclusion still requires current verification.
